requests.evidence: Boundary/title/easement record, control monuments and independent check, horizontal CRS/realization/epoch, grid-to-ground basis, exact length units, vertical datum/height type, benchmarks, closures and uncertainty. Preserve original observations and transformation report.

Topography and breaklines, washes/pond/banks/outfalls, culverts and invert elevations, flood/drainage constraints, irrigation and wet areas, utility records/locates, existing roads/crossings and structures. Coverage/density/contours set by civil engineer, not this tool.

Subgrade stratigraphy, bearing/settlement, compaction/moisture, frost/erosion/scour where relevant, groundwater/irrigation, ballast and sub-ballast compatibility, drainage and testing. No assumed soil bearing, ballast depth or culvert size.

Selected wheel/rail geometry, rail profile/condition, wheelbase/truck centers, axle loads, suspension stiffness/travel, swept clearance, operating/reversing/maintenance cases.36in remains evaluation gauge, not compatibility proof.

Develop plan/profile and station tangents from actual survey and0%longitudinal target. Resolve minimum/transition/reverse curves, turnouts, end protection, loop/turnaround/reversing and stops. NorthPole position remains deferred. Do not route across an existing railroad from unrelated farm plans.

requests.accountable: Surveyor + track engineer / approved inspection team
requests.evidence: Accepted datum and sampling, actual gauge face/depth, crosslevel, rail profile/wear, joints/fasteners, twist over selected vehicle bases, clearances, settlement and drainage observations. Engineer-defined limits, uncertainty and hold points before public operation.

survey_input_scope: Checker receives only track-reference centerline or paired rail observations. Terrain, boundary/geotech and design records remain separate required deliverables.
